name: dun
description: An open-source coding agent for the terminal, for long working sessions on any OpenAI-compatible model. Written in Go.

steps: curl -fsSL https://dun.iodesystems.com/install.sh | sh  (or download dun_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz and put dun on PATH)

verify.method: minisign verifies dun-manifest.json; the manifest lists each file's sha256

capabilities: models: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (hosted, gateway, or local); no built-in provider
models: reasoning effort per dialect (llama.cpp, OpenRouter, OpenAI-style via LiteLLM, Anthropic)
tools: exec in the host or in Docker (an image or a Dockerfile)
tools: file tools read, grep, list, edit, write
tools: recap (replaces churn in the context with an account of it)
mcp: global, project and session on/off switches per server
mcp: scripted mode inside mcpshell (tool schemas leave every request)
context: window learned from the server or set per model
context: command output over 20,000 characters cut to start and end, whole saved to a file
sessions: run in a local service (dund)
sessions: web and phone clients (experimental, untested)
sessions: scheduled messages (/schedule; push, edit, cancel before sending)
sessions: /loop, paced by interval or by the model (loop_ctl)
rules and skills: listed with token cost, switched per session, project or global
